answer: CONTRACTS v1.10 item 3 (mission.script) backing research (2026-09-02). DETECTION: the clean mechanism is thread enumeration, not hash guessing: SCRIPT_THREAD_ITERATOR_RESET (0xDADFADA5A20143A8) + SCRIPT_THREAD_ITERATOR_GET_NEXT_THREAD_ID (0x30B4FA1C82DD4B9F, returns 0 at end) + _GET_NAME_OF_THREAD (0x05A42BA9FC8DA96B) reads every running script thread's NAME directly. Alternative per-name probe: _GET_NUMBER_OF_REFERENCES_OF_SCRIPT_WITH_NAME_HASH (0x2C83A9DA6BFFC4F9, 'actually returns numRefs - 1') > 0 means an instance is loaded/running (thread instances, and mission scripts can spawn helper sub-threads). HAS_SCRIPT_WITH_NAME_HASH_LOADED (0x5F0F0C783EB16C04) is weaker (streamed-in, not necessarily running). GET_MISSION_FLAG (0xA33CDCCDA663159E) is confirmed real; its getter description is undocumented - semantics inferred from SET_MISSION_FLAG ('if true, the player can't save'). UNVERIFIED (must check live per rule 2): whether references>0 / a mission-named thread exists outside the actual mission window (e.g. during pre-mission streaming); therefore the bridge emits mission.script ONLY while mission.active (GET_MISSION_FLAG) is true, and the live smoke check must confirm the thread name appears with the flag. SCRIPT NAMES: every name below is CONFIRMED to exist verbatim in the decompiled-scripts dump (YimMenu/GTA-V-Decompiled-Scripts all_script_names.txt): prologue1; armenian1-3; family1-6; lamar1; franklin0-2; michael1-4 (+michael4leadout); trevor1-4; fbi1-4, fbi4_intro, fbi4_prep1-5, fbi5a; jewelry_heist, jewelry_prep1a/1b/2a, jewelry_setup1; agency_heist1/2/3a/3b, agency_prep1, agency_prep2amb; finale_heist1, finale_heist2_intro, finale_heist2a/2b, finale_heist_prepa-d, finale_heist_prepeamb, finale_choice, finalea, finaleb, finalec1/c2, finale_endgame, finale_intro, finale_credits; solomon1-3; martin1; exile1-3; docks_heista/b, docks_prep1, docks_prep2b, docks_setup; rural_bank_heist, rural_bank_prep1 (this IS The Paleto Score's script - no 'paleto_score' name exists); lester1; carsteal2-4 (+carsteals1). Strangers/Freaks and side content also confirmed: barry1-4(3a,3c), epsilon1-8, nigel1(a-d)/2/3, omega1/2, fanatic1-3, abigail1/2, maude1, bailbond1-4, josh1-4, drf1-5, tonya1-5, chinese1/2, hao1, mrsphilips1/2, paparazzo1-4(3a/3b), minute1-3, extreme1-4, rampage1-5, thelastone. TITLE PAIRINGS ARE NOT VERIFIED: no sourced table pairing script name to English mission title was found (armenian1='Franklin and Lamar' etc. is community convention only). Consequence for the product: the bridge emits the RAW script name; the harness treats it as a stable identity key and LEARNS script<->title pairings from the real game (when the OCR'd title card and mission.script are observed together, record the pair in harness state) rather than shipping guessed pairings.

facts.claim: _GET_NUMBER_OF_REFERENCES_OF_SCRIPT_WITH_NAME_HASH 0x2C83A9DA6BFFC4F9 (SCRIPT ns) - int, 'Gets the number of instances of the specified script is currently running. Actually returns numRefs - 1' (rage::scrProgram::GetNumRefs(program) - 1); present in SHVDN v3 Hash enum

Thread enumeration: SCRIPT_THREAD_ITERATOR_RESET 0xDADFADA5A20143A8, SCRIPT_THREAD_ITERATOR_GET_NEXT_THREAD_ID 0x30B4FA1C82DD4B9F (0 = end), _GET_NAME_OF_THREAD 0x05A42BA9FC8DA96B, IS_THREAD_ACTIVE 0x46E9AE36D8FA6417 (takes thread id, not name hash)

HAS_SCRIPT_WITH_NAME_HASH_LOADED 0x5F0F0C783EB16C04 = loaded/streamed (weaker than running); GET_MISSION_FLAG 0xA33CDCCDA663159E confirmed (getter description body empty; SET_MISSION_FLAG 0xC4301E5121A0ED73 documented: 'If true, the player can't save the game')

Story-mission script names confirmed verbatim (990-line all_script_names.txt fetched and grepped): prologue1, armenian1-3, family1-6, lamar1, franklin0-2, michael1-4, trevor1-4, fbi1-5a, jewelry_heist(+preps), agency_heist1-3b(+preps), finale_* set, solomon1-3, martin1, exile1-3, docks_heista/b(+preps), rural_bank_heist(+prep1), lester1, carsteal2-4, plus Strangers-and-Freaks families (barry, epsilon, nigel, omega, fanatic, abigail, maude, bailbond, josh, drf, tonya, chinese, hao, mrsphilips, paparazzo, minute, extreme, rampage, thelastone)

NOT verified: script-name -> English-title pairings (no sourced table found); whether a mission-named thread/references>0 occurs outside the mission window; GET_MISSION_FLAG getter semantics beyond inference. Product consequence: emit raw script name only while mission.active; harness learns title pairings from real observed (OCR title, script) co-occurrences
